The Donald Trump administration has proposed fresh tariffs on 14 major trading partners, including India, China, Japan and the European Union, following an eight-month investigation into alleged excess manufacturing capacity and industrial subsidies.
India could face tariffs of up to 25% on exports to the US, although the proposed rate could drop to 17% if New Delhi finalises a trade agreement with Washington. China faces an additional proposed 20% tariff under the latest investigation.
